question: Let $\binom{n}{k}$ denote the binomial coefficient $\frac{n!}{k!(n-k)!}$, and $F_m$ be the $m$th Fibonacci number given by $F_1=F_2=1$ and $F_{m+2}=F_m+F_{m+1}$ for all $m\ge1$. Show that $$\sum \binom{n}{k}=F_{m+1}\quad\text{for all }m\ge1.$$ Here, the above sum is over all pairs of integers $n\ge k\ge0$ with $n+k=m$.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
